transcription_notes: Cambridge UL MS Add. 1570 (CAM), dense 3-column Ethiopic book hand with red rubrication; 1588-89 CE. Hi-res CUDL folios. IMPORTANT LAYOUT FINDING (deviates from dispatch premise): the assigned folios f128r/f128v do NOT contain the body of 1Ki5. 1Ki5 actually begins on the PREVIOUS folio f127v (right column) and ENDS near the top of f128r left column; the rest of f128r and all of f128v are 1Ki6->1Ki7 (temple construction). Verified by vision: f127v-R top shows the 1Ki4 wisdom tail ('all peoples/kings came to hear his wisdom') then a red section rubric (klf 6) then 1Ki5:1 'ወፈነወ ኪራም ... ጢሮስ አግብርቲሁ ኀበ ሰሎምን' (Hiram of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon). 1Ki5 runs down the whole of f127v-R; the levy verse (5:13-14) SPLITS across the f127v-R-bottom -> f128r-L-top folio turn (f127v-R ends '...ወይፀኑ እምኔሆሙ', f128r-L line 1 resumes 'ደይ ፡ ውስተ ሊባኖስ ...'). 1Ki5 ENDS at f128r-L line 11 after '...ለሐኒጸ ቤት', followed by red rubric klf 9 and the 1Ki6:1 opening 'በ ፬፻ ወ ፹ ዓመት ... ወወጠነ ሐኒጸ ቤተ እግዚእብሔር' (in the 480th year... began to build the house) -- transcription STOPS there (did NOT enter ch6). Because the real ch5 is on f127v + f128r-L, this witness was transcribed from BOTH (same CAM manuscript witness; blindness not broken -- no GG/other-witness/printed-Bible consulted). f127v image used: MS-ADD-01570_f127v_1ki4_hires.jpg (the same physical folio also tagged _1ki3_). Intra-chapter red sub-rubrics observed: klf 6 (at ch5 start, f127v-R), klf 7 (5:12, f127v-R), klf 8 (5:17, f128r-L), klf 9 (ch5 end / ch6 start, f128r-L) -- these are liturgical subdivisions, not modern chapter marks. Divine name: the CAM hand writes 'እግዚእብሔር' (1st-order እ), NOT the printed 'እግዚአብሔር' (verified clearly at 5:3,4,5,12); transcribed as inked per the cardinal rule. Numeral stacks for the levy (70,000 / 80,000) and Hiram's payment (20,000 wheat measures) are written red and ✣-bracketed as '፸ ፻' / '፹ ፻' / '፳ ፻'; the hundred-vs-myriad multiplier mark is at the resolution limit and is flagged damaged (the magnitudes 70,000/80,000/20,000 are the narrative-expected values but the inked multiplier glyph is ambiguous). v1 has a faded scribal correction-oval at the 'ኪራም ... ጢሮስ' junction (the expected 'ንጉሠ' is not cleanly legible) -- flagged uncertain rather than smoothed to the printed form. No homoeoteleuton drop detected at the f127v->f128r turn (continuity proven glyph-by-glyph). Side-margin marginalia ignored per design-spec.
